Subject: Meeting notes + action items — SIG retention mapping & upload plan

Hi all — notes from today’s call (recording has been shared to the Drive link below). Short summary and action items: 

Summary
- Scope: FieldBridge requested SIG-Lite + CAIQ sections focused on logging, telemetry retention, and export controls.
- Retention examples: we reviewed defaults and per-customer config for three telemetry types:
  * API access logs — default 90 days; configurable to 365 days for Dedicated/Private deployments; archived to cold storage after 90 days (immutable snapshots for 180 days if requested).
  * Inference request traces (non-pii) — default 30 days; customers can opt into longer retention for debugging (explicit contract + extra cost).
  * KV cache entries — ephemeral per-session by default (24 hours); for Dedicated customers we offer configurable kv-ttl and explicit backup export.
- Upload options agreed: FieldBridge will use a temporary SFTP endpoint we provisioned. They will upload redacted logs (no PII), with README describing sampling windows and filters.

Action items (owner — due)
1) Sergio: provide SFTP credentials + upload instructions and a short README template for sample logs (Due: 2027-04-29) — Attachment: logs-sample-readme.txt
2) Marissa: collect evidence owners and map SIG/CAIQ rows to Redwood artifacts (Due: 2027-05-03)
3) Kimberly: confirm control mapping for retention settings and provide a brief config screenshot for Dedicated customers (Due: 2027-05-04)
4) Lauren/FieldBridge: upload one set of redacted API logs to SFTP and confirm successful transfer (Due: 2027-05-02)

Evidence requested (we discussed specifics on the call):
- API access log sample (7-day window, anonymized IPs)
- One inference request trace (debug-level, remove any user identifiers)
- Screenshot of Admin console showing retention toggle for Dedicated tenant (if available)
- Relevant config file or documentation for KV TTL behavior

Attachments we shared in-call:
- sig-questionnaire-initial-fill.xlsx (FieldBridge draft)
- logs-sample-readme.txt (Sergio — template to follow)

Links
- Shared Drive (call recording + artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFgHIjk
